author: manydoorsedboys
quote:
14 hours in, when does it get fun? It feels like Jason was a secondary character thrust into being the protag, and not very well. The freedom enjoyed in previous titles is just straight up not here. Movement is sluggish, nothing feels as snappy as even 5 did (which was pretty delayed in some inputs).

Overall it just doesn't feel like a GTA game story wise or gameplay wise
